items.caption:
In 2012, Nvidia was worth $7.7B. Today it's $5.24T, the most valuable AI company on Earth.

14 years of year-end market value for listed AI chip, cloud and platform companies, from the AlexNet era to the ChatGPT boom. Apple, Tesla and private labs like OpenAI are not included.

→ Nvidia tripled in 2023, from $364B to $1.22T
→ Nvidia passed Microsoft at the end of 2024: $3.29T vs $3.20T
→ Oct 15, 2026: Nvidia $5.24T, Alphabet $4.22T, Microsoft $4.00T

Which AI company will be on top in 2030?

In 2001, Toyota was worth $94B. Today Tesla is worth $1.43T, over 6x Toyota.

26 years of year-end market value for listed car makers, from Toyota's long reign to Tesla's rise and BYD's climb. Xiaomi is not included.

→ Tesla passed Toyota in 2020: $669B vs $216B
→ Volkswagen hit $128B in 2013, second only to Toyota
→ Oct 2026: Tesla $1.43T, Toyota $226B, BYD $113B, GM $73B, Ferrari $70B

items.caption:
In 2000 Citi was the most valuable bank at $256B. Today JPMorgan is worth $907B.

26 years of year-end market value for listed banks: Citi's early lead, China's ICBC taking the top spot in 2007, then JPMorgan's long climb to double the next bank.

→ Citi fell from $274B in 2006 to $38B in 2008
→ ICBC led in 2007 with $453B; JPMorgan had $147B
→ Oct 2026: JPMorgan $907B, China Construction Bank $449B, Agricultural Bank of China $380B, Bank of America $364B

In 2005 Microsoft was worth $272B and Oracle $63B. Today Palantir is worth $448B.

22 years of year-end market value for listed software companies: Microsoft's lead, Salesforce and Adobe's rise, then Palantir, Shopify and CrowdStrike joining the top ranks.

→ Adobe peaked at $272B in 2023; Oct 2026 it is $95B
→ Palantir went from $13B in 2022 to $450B in 2025
→ Oct 2026: Microsoft $3.92T, Palantir $448B, Oracle $392B, Palo Alto Networks $279B

In 1950 China had 544 million people and India 346 million. In 2022 India passed China.

76 years of UN population data: China's long lead, India's slow catch-up, and the year it flipped. The 2024-2026 values are UN medium-variant estimates.

→ 2022: India 1,425,423,209 vs China 1,425,179,562
→ 2026 est.: India 1.48B, China 1.41B, United States 349M
→ Nigeria grew from 37M in 1950 to 242M in 2026 est.

Which country will be third in 2050?

items.caption:
Norway led the Winter Olympics medal count from 1924 to 1980. Then the USSR took over.

Every Winter Games from 1924 to Milano Cortina 2026, counted as running totals. Norway had 17 medals after Chamonix and 447 after 2026. Germany, counted as one team (East, West and unified), now has 461.

→ 2026 totals: Germany 461, Norway 447, Russia 384 (USSR/ROC counted together), United States 363
→ Norway won 41 medals at Milano Cortina 2026 alone
→ Austria 269, Canada 246, Sweden 195, Switzerland 191

Which country takes the lead at the next Winter Games?
